newsitem.title: USA: Data Systems gets New York State contract.
newsitem.headline: Data Systems gets New York State contract.

text.p: Data Systems Network Corp said Thursday its Information Decisions Solutions division had won a contract from New York State.
Orders are expected to generate about $1 million by January 1 and about $2 million by next July, when the contract is up for renewal, the company said.

The contract includes providing the state and its agencies with a wide variety of computer equipment and services. Orders have already been received, but some shipments may not occur until the first quarter of 1997, it said.
